question: Can the deterministic entity-factored producer planner replace the v4 producer in the current product-stream stochastic champion stack, without per-topology regression, death, or strict-envelope regression?
scope: producer replacement audit only; no orderer retraining, no learned scorer, no champion overwrite

controller.champion: v4 producer from checkpoint + stochastic product-stream orderer from checkpoint
controller.candidate: PRODUCING_BASELINES['entity_planner'] + the same stochastic product-stream orderer

summary_csv.result: candidate beats champion mean and strict-envelope mean on all four topologies, zero death

audit40_vs_champion_csv.result: candidate is zero-death and positive on seeds 7/8/9, but regresses seed 6 by 1.125 consumer units on the mean

promotion_gate.death_rate: candidate must be zero death on every held-out topology
promotion_gate.champion_regression: candidate mean must be >= champion mean on every held-out topology
promotion_gate.strict_envelope: candidate must clear strict envelope; checked at 10 eval seeds only in this local run

verdict: REJECT producer replacement promotion; keep v4 producer in champion stack
